title: Knowledge Distiller
subtitle: Groups similar notes and condenses each group into a single learning.
lede: Groups similar notes and condenses each group into a single learning. It slims long memory files by compressing low-value sections after backing up the original, writes a recent-activity summary into project folders, and publishes a "what we learned" feed.
who: A knowledge manager who wants fewer, better notes
author: Corey James
